title: StreamEmbed: Real-Time Indexing from Pixels for Screenshot Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.18516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Screen history can serve as searchable visual memory for people and agents, but unlike an offline corpus, it must be encoded and indexed as each screenshot arrives. OCR-based indexing is fast but loses visual information; visual encoding takes over two seconds. Yet screens change incrementally: most pixels repeat within and across screenshots. This raises a question: do visual encoders need to recompute their representations from scratch for every new screenshot? We present StreamEmbed, a system for incremental visual embedding that exploits this redundancy. Guided solely by pixel differences, it combines spatial token pruning, which skips blocks that repeat a neighbor, with temporal KV reuse, which reuses cached keys and values for blocks unchanged across screenshots. A small learned adapter compensates for pruning and reuse to preserve fidelity to full-screenshot embeddings. On ScreenMemEval, our benchmark of 10,426 questions over 18

translated_title: StreamEmbed：面向屏幕截图检索的从像素到索引的实时编码
translated_abstract: 屏幕历史可以作为人类和智能体的可搜索视觉记忆，但与离线语料库不同，它必须在每张截图到达时即时进行编码和索引。基于OCR的索引方式速度快，但会丢失视觉信息；而视觉编码则需要超过两秒的时间。然而屏幕是增量变化的：大多数像素在单张截图内部以及跨截图之间都是重复的。这引出了一个问题：视觉编码器是否需要为每张新截图从头重新计算其表示？我们提出了StreamEmbed，一个利用这种冗余性的增量视觉嵌入系统。它仅由像素差异引导，结合了空间token剪枝（跳过与邻近块重复的块）和时间KV复用（对跨截图未变化的块复用缓存的键和值）。一个小的可学习适配器对剪枝和复用进行补偿，以保持与完整截图嵌入的一致性。在ScreenMemEval——我们的基准测试（包含针对18……的10,426个问题）——上……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: StreamEmbed利用屏幕像素的冗余性，通过仅依据像素差异的空间token剪枝和跨截图时间KV缓存复用，实现增量式视觉嵌入，从而对不断到来的屏幕截图进行实时编码与索引，同时保持与全图嵌入相当的精度。
en_tdlr: StreamEmbed achieves real-time incremental visual embedding for streaming screenshots by exploiting pixel redundancy—spatial token pruning and temporal KV reuse guided solely by pixel differences—avoiding recomputing representations from scratch for every new screenshot while preserving fidelity to full-screenshot embeddings.
